summary: Add an album to the user's myalbums list
description: Adds the specified album to the authenticated user's list of favorite albums (myalbums). Requires a valid client_id and an OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope. Returns an empty results array and header information indicating success.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes the 'results_fullcount' value (performance impact).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid access token (with 'music' scope) for the Jamendo user to update.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: The id of the album that should be added to the user's albums list

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request outcome, including status and result counts.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: List of results; empty for this method.

notes: The response always contains an empty "results" array.
Both client_id and access_token are required; client_id acts as the API key.
`format` accepts only the values xml, json, or jsonpretty.
`fullcount` can affect performance and should be used only when needed.
